help.install.title: Install and updates
help.install.ios.title: Add to Home Screen on iPhone
help.install.ios.step2: Tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.
help.install.ios.step3: Open it from the Home Screen icon to play full screen.
help.install.update.title: The game says an update is ready
help.install.update.step1: Finish what you are doing, then choose Restart in the update notice.
help.install.update.step2: If nothing happens, close every tab of the game and open it again.
help.performance.title: Performance
help.performance.slow.title: The game runs slowly
help.performance.slow.step1: Open Settings, then Graphics, and choose a lower quality.
help.performance.slow.step3: On a phone, keep it plugged in and out of the sun.
help.performance.load.title: The game will not finish loading
help.performance.load.step1: Check your connection and reload the page.
help.performance.load.step2: Open Settings, then Install and storage, and check free space.
help.performance.load.step3: If it still stops, copy the diagnostics from the error page and send them with your report.
help.graphics.title: Graphics and crashes
help.graphics.gpu.title: Graphics could not start
help.graphics.gpu.step1: Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings.
help.graphics.gpu.step2: Update your browser and your graphics driver.
help.graphics.gpu.step3: Try compatibility mode in Settings, then Graphics.
help.graphics.crash.title: The game stopped
help.graphics.crash.step1: Reload the page: you return to your last save.
help.graphics.crash.step2: Lower the quality in Settings if it happens often.
help.graphics.crash.step3: Copy the diagnostics from the Pause menu when you report it.
help.audio.title: Audio
help.audio.silent.title: There is no sound
help.audio.silent.step1: Tap or press a key once: the browser waits for a first touch before it plays audio.
help.audio.silent.step2: Check the volume sliders in Settings, then Audio.
help.audio.silent.step3: Check that the device is not on silent.
help.controls.title: Controls and gamepads
help.controls.pad.title: My gamepad is not found
help.controls.pad.step1: Press any button on the gamepad while the game is open.
help.controls.pad.step2: Connect it before you open the page, or reconnect it.
help.controls.remap.title: Change a control
help.controls.remap.step2: Choose the device, select the control and press the new key or button.
help.saves.title: Saves and storage
help.saves.storage.title: Progress cannot be saved
help.saves.storage.step1: Leave private browsing: it does not keep saves.
help.saves.storage.step2: Free space on the device, then reload.
help.saves.storage.step3: Export your profile from Saves to keep a copy.
help.saves.lost.title: My save is missing
help.saves.lost.step1: Open Saves and look at every profile.
help.saves.lost.step2: Import an export file if you have one.
help.vr.title: VR
help.vr.enter.title: Enter VR is missing
help.vr.enter.step2: The button shows only when the browser reports that VR is ready.
help.online.title: Online and account
help.online.region.title: This game is not available here
help.online.region.step1: The game is not offered in some regions yet.
help.online.region.step2: Your local saves are not affected.
help.online.signin.title: I cannot sign in
help.online.signin.step2: Playing without an account is always possible.
